thread:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — we've hit a snag. Vendor called: A800 SKU backorder is 8-10w. We need to discuss alternatives for dedicated ramp. Who can take a quick pass on options? @tomas @procurement
Tomas Rivera: On it. procurement found a smaller batch of 4x A800-equivalents (vendor B) but they are 64GB instead of 80GB. ETA 3w for delivery + 1w staging. Price + lead still TBD.
Priya Kapoor: 64GB works for most of the QA stack, but we need to confirm we can still hit our 95th p99 latency SLO for folding tests. Which workloads will land on these nodes?
Zach Li: Primary inference tiers (small models) + canary. Large-model training slices must stay on 80GB. Need to update model-routing policy if we accept.
Ben Ortiz: Can we split reservation? We have commitment for 40 GPUs in week 16 — need a clear fallback plan. If vendor B is 3w, that's week 14 delivery — still OK? Also need to update billing & committed capacity doc.
Maya Chen: Proposal: take 24 GPUs from vendor B to unblock canaries, reserve remaining 16 for original SKU when available. Owners: @tomas for procurement, @priya for infra validation, @zach for routing changes. Agree? :+1:
Tomas Rivera: I can lead procurement. I'll ping legal for the short-term PO change. Getting vendor contact now.
capacity-bot: Reservation created: temp-pivot-vendorB-24 — tentative. ID: res-2025-31415. TTL 30d.
Priya Kapoor: Quick check — are these 64GB nodes the same PCIe config? Need to confirm NVLINK layout. If NVLINK missing we lose multi-GPU model shards.
Tomas Rivera: Vendor B confirmed 2x NVLINK bridges per cabinet, same as spec. I'll add exact part numbers to the ticket.
Zach Li: Routing notes: will add a model variant tag `v64` and add cost-latency flag. Example change:
```
route: inference-primary
allow_models: [resnet, llama-small]
device_profile: v64
fallback: route: inference-fallback
```
Maya Chen: QA plan: Priya to run smoke perf on 4 nodes next Tue. If pass, we can flip canaries by Wed. Priya, Ben — can you slot tests?
Priya Kapoor: Slotting Tue 10-13 PT. I'll need kube creds and the staging image sha.
Ben Ortiz: I'll update the capacity calendar and notify customers with tentative dates. Also filing CR to finance.
Tomas Rivera: FYI legal asked for a short addendum — I'll attach to the PO by EOD.
Zach Li: If perf regresses >5% on p99 we rollback routing within 30m. I'll add alerting to the console (runbook link: https://go/runbooks/capacity-pivots).
Maya Chen: Thanks. we'll reconvene Fri if anything changes. Keeping async here — ping if blockers. :wave:
